name: Danaher Side Crucifix System
description: A focused companion to John Danaher’s Master The Move: The Side Crucifix, distinguishing underhook acquisition, arm pinning and later submission branches.
summary: Locate the underhook, near-arm pinning or submission branch you need within Danaher’s side-crucifix study.
overview: Master The Move: The Side Crucifix by John Danaher gives separate attention to obtaining an underhook from a settled pin and obtaining one during an entry. Later volumes explore chancery, shin pins and submission branches. This makes the course a specific arm-isolation study within the wider top game.

flashcards.question: What two underhook-acquisition contexts does Danaher’s side-crucifix study distinguish?
flashcards.answer: Obtaining an underhook after settling in side control and obtaining it before side control, during an entry. The public outline gives these contexts separate sections.
